$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.common.expressions. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-EMPTY-STMT-BEFORE-ELSE-OFF
arms.note: only a `;` past a statement's last child is found, so `if (…) { … }; else` keeps its stray `;` unreported

arms.name: M-EMPTY-STMT-QUOTATION-BLIND
arms.find: final class EmptyStatement extends RuleBase implements QuotationAware {
arms.note: the rule takes the central reification drop again, so a stray `;` inside a `macro class` is neither reported nor fixed

arms.name: M-JSUL-ANNOTATION-NEVER-NEUTRAL
arms.note: an annotation is never proven type-neutral, so a declaration whose annotation merely restates its source type stops collapsing

arms.name: M-JSUL-COMMENT-ANY-IN-FILE
arms.note: any comment in the file counts as one inside the deleted line, so a comment merely standing BETWEEN the two statements blocks the join

arms.name: M-JSUL-PATH-ALWAYS-CONDITIONAL
arms.note: every read path counts as conditional, so a field chain on a straight-line path is refused as if it had moved under a branch

arms.name: M-JSUL-BARE-IDENT-NOT-SAFE
arms.note: the bare-identifier exemption goes, so a plain local read is refused on a conditional path even though reading it has no effect at all

arms.name: M-JSUL-LOCAL-CAPTURE-ANY
arms.find: return bindingFrom != null && TypeResolver.mayBeLocalOrParam(tree, bindingFrom, s.mutableKinds, []);
arms.note: every local capture reads as a mutable one, so capturing an IMMUTABLE local stops collapsing along with the var case the gate exists for

arms.name: M-JSUL-UNINDEXED-NAME-ALWAYS
arms.note: every site reads as carrying an unindexed use of the name, so a shape with no stray read past the pair is refused with the ones that have one

arms.name: M-JSUL-INIT-IDENT-ALWAYS-REBOUND
arms.note: every initializer identifier reads as re-bound before the read, so a binder under a DIFFERENT name is treated as a capture

arms.name: M-PARENS-SPLICE-HOST-OPEN
arms.note: a pair around $a{...} in a splicing host drops, so the quoted call's arity changes

arms.name: M-PARENS-OPERAND-QUOTED-OPEN
arms.note: the atoms arm drops a quoted operand pair, whose content may be a splice of unknown precedence

arms.name: M-BIND-WRITES-IGNORED
arms.find: return !Refs.find(name, ctx.root, shape).exists(hit -> hit.kind == RefKind.Write && hit.bindingSpan?.from == from);
arms.note: a local written after the lambda is created still counts as unchanging

arms.name: M-BIND-FIELD-ARG
arms.note: any identifier, a field included, is a stable bind argument

arms.name: M-BIND-NULLABLE-ARG
arms.note: a `Null<T>` binding is bound although null safety rejects it as an argument

arms.name: M-BIND-FIELD-RECEIVER
arms.find: if (receiver.kind != shape.identKind || receiverName == null) return false;
arms.replace:
if (receiver.kind != shape.identKind || receiverName == null) return false;
		return true;
arms.note: any single-level receiver is read as stable

arms.name: M-LOCALFN-RESULT-DROPPED
arms.note: the declared result is not carried, so the hoisted declaration infers its type from the body

arms.name: M-LOCALFN-SIGNATURE-ANY
arms.note: any literal signature is taken to reproduce the declared function type

arms.name: M-LOCALFN-VOID-RETURNED
arms.note: an expression body under a `Void` result is returned rather than wrapped

arms.name: M-BIND-METHOD-UNPROVEN
arms.note: any member the owner declares under the name is taken as a closable, unchanging method

arms.name: M-BIND-DYNAMIC-CALLEE
arms.note: a `dynamic` method, rebindable after the callback is created, is bound

arms.name: M-BIND-CLOSURELESS-CALLEE
arms.note: a macro or an overloaded method, which has no closure to bind, is bound

arms.name: M-BIND-UNDECLARED-BARE
arms.note: a bare callee name the enclosing type does not declare is taken as a method

arms.name: M-LOCALFN-OUTER-NAME-READ
arms.note: an initializer literal reading an outer function of the binding's name is hoisted into self-recursion

arms.name: M-BIND-LIBRARY-CALLEE
arms.note: a library or standard-library method, which a target may override as `extern inline`, is bound

arms.name: M-BIND-EXTERN-TYPE
arms.note: a member of an `extern` type is bound

arms.name: M-BIND-ABSTRACT-SELF
arms.note: an abstract's instance method is bound through an implicit `this` the abstract may reassign

arms.name: M-RLW-NAMED-FN-NOT-BINDER
arms.note: a named function literal does not shadow a member callee, so the member's signature answers for it and a reduction the compiler rejects is proposed

arms.name: M-RLW-LOCAL-FN-AS-BINDER
arms.note: a local function counts as a shadowing binder rather than as the callee it is, so `p -> ok(p)` over a local `function ok` is never reduced

arms.name: M-EMPTY-BLOCK-DRAIN-LOOP
arms.note: no loop is a drain loop, so `while (gl.getError() != 0) {}` is reported as a forgotten body although its condition does the work

arms.name: M-EMPTY-BLOCK-NO-DECLINE
arms.note: a kept empty block carries no decline note, so the --fix ledger reports a bare 'returned no edit' for every loop / catch / side-effecting if

arms.name: M-JSUL-SOURCE-ALWAYS-WRITTEN
arms.note: every source reads as written somewhere, so a parameter nothing writes stops collapsing into a later read

arms.name: M-JSUL-SOURCE-NEVER-WRITTEN
arms.note: no source reads as written, so a parameter assigned before or after the read, or from a closure, is inlined into a later statement that may see another value

arms.name: M-JSUL-LATER-HOLDER-ADJACENT-ONLY
arms.note: only the immediately following sibling is searched for the read, so a capture read several statements later is never found

arms.name: M-JSUL-LATER-DEFERRED-ALLOWED
arms.note: a later read inside a lambda declared between is accepted, moving the read into a closure

arms.name: M-JSUL-LATER-LOOP-BARRIER
arms.note: a loop on the path refuses a later read even though the invariant source makes every repetition read the same value

arms.name: M-JSUL-LATER-SOURCE-ANY-BINDER
arms.note: any resolved binder counts as invariant, so a catch binder outside the parameter and final-local whitelist is inlined into a later read

arms.name: M-JSUL-LATER-SOURCE-ANY-SCOPE
arms.find: if (fnSpan == null || binding.from < fnSpan.from || binding.to > fnSpan.to) return false;
arms.note: an outer function's parameter counts as owned by the nested function, so its capture is inlined into a later read past the whitelist

arms.name: M-JSUL-LATER-SOURCE-PARAMS-ONLY
arms.note: only parameters count as invariant, so a capture of a final local read several statements later stops collapsing

arms.name: M-JSUL-LATER-LEADING-COMMENT-IGNORED
arms.note: the later-read fix deletes a capture under an own-line comment, which then documents whatever statement followed it

arms.name: M-CPREC-NESTED-EDITS-OVERLAP
arms.find: !spans.exists(outer -> outer != span && outer.from <= span.from && span.to <= outer.to)
arms.note: a flagged operand nested in another flagged one is wrapped in the same pass, so two edits overlap

arms.name: M-PB-STRING-BLOCK
arms.note: a string holding a ${...} expression counts as a stable literal and is bound at creation time

arms.name: M-ETA-STD-ARM-UNSPLIT
arms.note: a std callee's finding is no longer the risky arm's, so the oracle is never asked and the rewrite never lands

arms.name: M-ETA-STD-STATIC-NEVER-PROVEN
arms.note: no std static is ever proven, so the rule stays silent on Reflect.compare as before

arms.name: M-ETA-STD-FIX-KEEPS-STD
arms.note: the safe fix rewrites a std callee without the oracle's compile check
